messages.author: c6ca7877bef91eef
messages.subject: Re: html output (e.g. from plotGoogleMaps) in shiny tabset
parts:
The problem is that plotGoogleMaps emits a full HTML file, which needs to be included as an IFrame in the Shiny App. Here is a minimal example. I have taken the basic example from the package vignette. You will notice that I use tags$iframe(srcdoc = ....) as the return value. What this does is returns the HTML file as a string, which is then embedded inline as an iframe. You can also include the myMap1.html file directly using tags$iframe(src = ...), but I am a little unclear as to its path in a Shiny app.

I have put this in a gist https://gist.github.com/ramnathv/275fe2a088e539f6b1ca so that you can copy and paste.

library(plotGoogleMaps)
library(shiny)
runApp(list(
  ui = pageWithSidebar(
    headerPanel('Map'),
    sidebarPanel(""),
    mainPanel(uiOutput('mymap'))
  ),
  server = function(input, output){
    output$mymap <- renderUI({
      data(meuse)
      coordinates(meuse) = ~x+y
      proj4string(meuse) <- CRS("+init=epsg:28992")
      m <- plotGoogleMaps(meuse, filename = 'myMap1.html', openMap = F)
      tags$iframe(
        srcdoc = paste(readLines('myMap1.html'), collapse = '\n'),
        width = "100%",
        height = "600px"
      )
    })
  }
))
